briefdescription.para: Extended diagnostics framework with incident context and trace support.

sect1.title: Purpose
sect1.para: Extends the base diagnostics framework (process_diagnostics.h) with additional context for high-churn scenarios, distributed tracing, and advanced incident classification. Enables operator-facing diagnostics for process incident triage.

sect1.title: Context Layers
sect1.para:
Diagnostics now include four layers of context:
Incident Context: Classification of failure class (CHURN_DETECTION, etc.)
Trace Context: Correlation IDs for multi-step operations (trace_id, span_id)
Churn Metric: Concurrent operation count at time of incident
Conflict Analysis: Count and type of detected conflicts

sect1.title: Backward Compatibility
sect1.para: This version extends process_diagnostics.h with optional fields. Existing code using base DiagnosticRecord continues to work; new context fields are optional (std::optional).

sect1.title: Contract Version
sect1.para: v1.1.0 – Extends v1.0.0 with optional context fields (backward compatible)
